name: xtandard-kit-site
description: The documentation website (GitHub Pages): Astro Starlight over the repository's Markdown, plus a TypeDoc API reference, built on the kit's own @xtandard/kit/site (installed from the local build by scripts/link-kit.ts). Dev tooling only; not part of the published package.

scripts.dev: bun run link-kit && bun run sync && bun --bun astro dev
scripts.build: bun run link-kit && bun run sync && bun --bun astro build
